purpose: Test whether the 2025 disjoint EXPLORATORY_NULL / UNEXPLAINED reconcile (FCLR-FWD-VOL-2025-DISJOINT-CROSS-20261114T183000Z: pooled C2-B1 24h QLIKE relative reduction -1.963%, 95% CI [-0.012604, 0.028030]) is estimator-sensitive. Runs the corrected estimator (train-only standardization, finite-row masking, train-only log-target Duan smearing, drop-only missingness) on the frozen cached 2025 disjoint panel and contrasts against the recorded sealed reference from evaluation_summary_FCLR-FWD-VOL-2025-DISJOINT-CROSS-20261114T191615Z.json. No sealed scripts or artifacts are re-executed or mutated. All results EXPLORATORY_ONLY, promotable=false.

splits.design: three disjoint 30-day test blocks, each with its own 30-day train window
splits.block_rule: no padding, no imputation; any row-key or feature-lineage mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE

corrected.definition: train-only column means/std standardization, finite-feature masking (drop row, never fill), train-only Duan smearing on log-target residuals, OLS via least squares, explicit missingness policy (drop row; missing stays missing)

inference.bootstrap: day-block bootstrap over complete UTC days, pooled across blocks
inference.holm_family: horizon x contrast (primary C2_vs_B1 reported with family adjustment)
inference.loio: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate on the held-out instrument

verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR: corrected-estimator primary rel reduction swings from the sealed reference by >= 1.0 percentage point, or sign flip with max(|corrected|, |sealed|) >= 1.0
verdict_rule.NOT_EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR: corrected-estimator primary rel reduction is within 1.0 percentage point of the sealed reference with no material sign flip (the 2025 null is not estimator-sensitive)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: panel hash/row-key/lineage check fails, or a cell cannot be fitted

forbidden: re-executing sealed scripts as a new cell
relabeling an exploratory result as confirmatory
threshold shopping or feature changes after outcome inspection
declaring Gate 4 Binance v5 terms evidence resolved
